taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO. Older Texas literature often used Vitis candicans; current learner uses Vitis mustangensis.

evidence: Hays County — UT Plant Resources Center Purola Preserve lists Vitis mustangensis among plants occurring naturally and not introduced.
Travis County — Texas A&M AgriLife Travis County describes Mustang grape as a wild grape growing in Austin/Travis greenbelts and wild areas.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center provides a detailed field-based treatment of Vitis mustangensis.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer county nativity from planted vineyard/rootstock material.

morphology.look_here_first: Flip the leaf first. Mustang grape has a dense white-to-rusty woolly tomentum on the lower surface that essentially hides the blade surface and veins. Then confirm broad heart- to kidney-shaped leaves and large dark berries usually 12 mm or more.
diagnostic_traits: vigorous high-climbing woody vine with shredding bark
young branchlets densely to sparsely tomentose
leaves broad cordate to nearly reniform, usually unlobed or shallowly lobed but sometimes deeply 3–5-lobed on vigorous shoots
leaf underside densely white to rusty tomentose, surface largely concealed by hairs
upper leaf surface becomes green and much less hairy
tendrils or inflorescences occur opposite leaves and at only two consecutive nodes
berries usually black or dark red, slightly or not glaucous, commonly 12+ mm

confusers.separator: Lower leaf surface is visible and only sparsely hairy to nearly glabrous in V. berlandieri; its fruit is more strongly glaucous and clusters are shorter/compact.
V. cinerea has a visible gray/green lower leaf surface with webby and short hairs rather than the solid white felt of V. mustangensis, and its berries are much smaller.
V. palmata has uniformly red/purplish branchlets and usually deeply lobed glabrous leaves, not a white-felted underside.

diagnostic_roles: leaf underside macro showing opaque white tomentum

installation_guardrail: May install under the user's standing blanket approval because strict PASS is complete.
